name: php-mcp-server-generator
description: Generate a complete PHP Model Context Protocol server with tools, resources, prompts, and tests using the official PHP SDK.

Create a complete, production-ready PHP MCP server project. Ask for: project name (e.g. `my-mcp-server`), server description, transport (stdio/http/both), tools, whether to include resources and prompts, and PHP version (PHP 8.2 or higher required).

Use Composer settings: `"name": "your-org/{project-name}"`, `"description": "{Server description}"`, `"optimize-autoloader": true`, `"preferred-install": "dist"`, `"sort-packages": true`.

Implement tools, resources, and prompts with `#[McpTool]`, `#[McpResource]`, `#[McpPrompt]`, `#[McpResourceTemplate]`, `#[Schema]`, and `#[CompletionProvider]` as applicable. Use `declare(strict_types=1);` in all files, PSR-12, PHPDoc for all methods, parameter schema validation, and clear specific exceptions. Always use PSR-16 cache for discovery in production.

Provide examples: greet (`Hello, {$name}!`); arithmetic add/divide with `Division by zero` and `Invalid operation` exceptions; `config://app/settings` JSON resource; `data://{category}/{id}` JSON template; code-review and documentation prompts; simple action, email validation, backed `Status` enum, settings, and user lookup (`User not found`). Include cache-backed server discovery, excluding `vendor`, `tests`, `cache`, with `StdioTransport` when stdio is selected.

Write PHPUnit tests for all tools, including greeting, arithmetic success, division by zero, and invalid operation. Configure PHPUnit to bootstrap `vendor/autoload.php` and include `tests` and `src` (`.php` suffix for `src`).

Run commands:
php server.php
vendor/bin/phpunit
npx <REDACTED_USER>/inspector php server.php

For MCP client configuration use `"args": ["/absolute/path/to/server.php"]`. Describe tools as **{tool_name}**: {Tool description}. Generate the complete project based on user requirements!
